claim: PPO trained on the antithetic-averaged reward: each episode is run as (ξ, −ξ) — the same actions against the shock path and its exact negation — and the two realised rewards are averaged. The observation carries no price, so both halves take identical actions, and because Phase-1 cost is affine in the shocks the noise cancels exactly on the average; the agent optimises the expected objective without the analytic noise form ever being subtracted. Under Phase-1 certainty equivalence the optimal policy is unchanged, so what is rediscovered does not move. This is NOT a claim about learning under noise: it is a claim about a variance-reduction estimator that needs only the ability to replay with negated draws, validated at M2's lambda against the control variate's committed answer (results/m3_antithetic_validation.json against results/m2_rediscovery.json) and against the sampled regime's recorded miss (results/m2_rediscovery_sampled.json). This file is one point of the M3 frontier sweep at the lambda it names, on the update budget the brief's amendment 1 fixed.
